submission.justification: S1 gives the highest expected significance (3.98 sigma at 50% efficiency, statistical only). S2 gives 3.35 and S3 gives 2.73. This agrees with the 2025 summary. I only simulated the 50% working point and did not scan other efficiencies, so it may not be the optimum. The project documents contain no data/MC validation-region results, so I could not check the hard 10% mismodelling limit. S1 uses jet substructure variables, which are often harder to model than kinematic variables. The validation-region agreement for S1's input variables must be checked before the selection is frozen. If any variable disagrees by more than 10%, fall back to S2, which uses kinematic variables only.

requirements.evidence: At 50% efficiency the simulation gave S1 3.98, S2 3.35 and S3 2.73 sigma. Other efficiencies were not scanned.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
Data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region at most 10% for the variables used
requirements.evidence: No validation-region data/MC comparison appears in any project document. S1 uses jet substructure, which is a mismodelling risk. This must be verified before freeze.
